name: Schedules
description: Starts a coding agent (Claude Code or OpenCode) with a prompt in one of your projects by itself: every few hours, or at a set time on the days you pick. It can also watch a project's Azure DevOps, GitHub or GitLab for tickets assigned to you, and offer to start an agent on each in a new worktree. Each run opens in a new tab and you get a notification. Wings has to be running, and a run missed while it was closed isn't made up.
mcpInstructions: Schedules (schedules__*): list shows every schedule and every assigned entry with the tickets assigned to the user and their state; add_assigned starts watching a project for assigned tickets; update changes one; remove deletes an entry. Use them when the user asks what is assigned to them or in which state, or wants an agent offered on newly assigned tickets in a project.

mcpTools.name: list
mcpTools.description: Lists every schedule and every assigned entry, one line each: id, kind, project, agent, enabled, and for an assigned entry its source, last check, the states it asks about and the tickets assigned to the user with their state and whether each is asked about. Then the tickets waiting for the user's answer. Read-only.

mcpTools.name: add_assigned
mcpTools.description: Adds an entry that watches a project's Azure DevOps, GitHub or GitLab for tickets assigned to the user and offers to start an agent on each in a new worktree. It checks once and returns what it found. One entry per project. Nothing starts until the user presses Start on the Schedules page.

project.description: A Wings project's name or its folder path.

prompt.description: What the agent is told. {id}, {title} and {url} become the ticket's number, title and link. Leave out for the default.

min_free_gb.description: Wings won't make a worktree when the disk has less free space than this. 10 by default.

states.description: The ticket states to ask about, like New or Ready for development. Leave out to pick the not-started ones after the first check.

title_prefixes.description: Ask only about tickets whose title starts with one of these, like FE or BE, when the project's tickets carry a prefix for each repo. Leave out for every title.

name.description: What the lists call the entry instead of "When something is assigned to me".

base.description: The branch a ticket's branch starts from, like origin/develop. Leave out for the repo's default branch.

mcpTools.name: check
mcpTools.description: Checks for assigned tickets now, in one assigned entry or in every enabled one, and returns what each found. Use it after a ticket was assigned, instead of waiting for the next check.

id.description: The id of an assigned entry, from list. Leave out to check every enabled one.

mcpTools.name: start
mcpTools.description: Starts an agent on one assigned ticket: makes a worktree on a feature branch and opens the agent in it, in the entry's project or another project of the same repo host and project. The ticket must be waiting, or listed by the last check in a state the entry asks about, and not started before. One that already has a branch, or was started before, needs force.

id.description: The id of the assigned entry, from list.

ticket.description: The ticket's number, as list shows it without the #.

force.description: Start a ticket in a state the entry doesn't ask about, one that already has a branch, or one started before.

project.description: Where to start it: a Wings project's name or folder path. Leave out for the entry's project.

mcpTools.name: update
mcpTools.description: Changes an assigned entry: only the fields given change, and an empty string or list clears one. The tickets it already asked about or started stay as they are.

id.description: The id of the assigned entry, from list.

prompt.description: What the agent is told. {id}, {title} and {url} become the ticket's number, title and link.

min_free_gb.description: Wings won't make a worktree when the disk has less free space than this.

states.description: The ticket states to ask about. An empty list asks about every state.

title_prefixes.description: Ask only about tickets whose title starts with one of these, like FE or BE.

name.description: What the lists call the entry instead of "When something is assigned to me". An empty string clears it.

base.description: The branch a ticket's branch starts from, like origin/develop.

mcpTools.name: remove
mcpTools.description: Removes a schedule or an assigned entry by its id from list. What it was waiting to ask about goes with it. Tabs it already started stay open.

id.description: The id of the entry, from list.
